hook: Eleven years of stopping traffic with a lollipop sign.

excerpt.text: She liked that moment more than she would have told anyone.

excerpt: Not because she was anybody. Because of the sign, and the law, and the children.

excerpt.text: It was the only time in her life she had been able to stop anything just by standing still.

caption:
A psychological thriller about the people we notice, the people we believe, and the courage it takes to stand still in the road.
